material.title: 学习成本与大学生活规划
material.theme: 国际教育 · 写作话题拓展
material.publisher: GOV.UK · 英国政府学生资助与还款说明
material.chinese: 在英格兰，符合条件的学生可以申请贷款，用于支付大学学费或生活费用。学费贷款直接支付给学校，而生活费贷款进入学生的银行账户。
material.translation: In England, eligible students can apply for loans to help pay university tuition fees or living expenses. Tuition fee loans are paid directly to the university, while maintenance loans are paid into students' bank accounts.
material.paragraph: 在英格兰，符合条件的学生可以申请贷款，用于支付大学学费或生活费用。学费贷款直接支付给学校，而生活费贷款进入学生的银行账户。这些贷款需要偿还，开始还款的时间和还款金额取决于适用的计划。对于学生来说，了解学习成本有助于提前规划大学生活。在比较不同的资助方式时，不仅要关注眼前能够获得多少资金，也应阅读相关说明，理解未来可能承担的责任。学校可以通过清晰的信息和必要的指导，帮助学生提出问题并作出更充分的准备。
material.paragraphTranslation: In England, eligible students can apply for loans to help pay university tuition fees or living expenses. Tuition fee loans are paid directly to the university, while maintenance loans are paid into students' bank accounts. These loans must be repaid, and the timing and amounts of repayments depend on the applicable plan. Understanding study costs helps students plan for university life in advance. When comparing different forms of financial support, they should not only consider how much funding is available now, but also read the relevant guidance to understand their future responsibilities. Schools can provide clear information and necessary guidance to help students ask questions and prepare more thoroughly.
material.pattern: be eligible for …（符合……条件） / help pay for …（帮助支付……） / not only … but also …（不仅……而且……）
material.prompt: Write 40–60 words explaining why university students should plan their study costs. Give one practical example.
material.sample: Planning study costs can help university students prepare for everyday needs. For example, listing expected spending on books, meals and transport makes it easier to discuss available support with their families. Clear information from universities can also help students ask useful questions and make thoughtful plans before a course begins.
checks: 注意 eligible students 与 can apply 的搭配
